findings.title: Eligibility-phrasing delta directly contradicts orbit-review's baseline stock phrasings — scope miss
findings.recommendation: The delta prohibits the imperative `Next:` label on every recommendation surface, but the un-delta'd baseline orbit/specs/orbit-review/spec.md MANDATES exact stock phrasings containing `Next: /orbit:...` in 8+ scenario THENs (proposal + system final-assessment tables, e.g. lines ~140-179 — the only baseline file with rendered `Next:` labels, verified by repo-wide grep). Post-archive the baseline would both mandate and prohibit the label. Add an orbit-review MODIFIED delta rewriting the stock phrasings to the eligibility label (`Ready when you are:` + ` — user-invoked` marker where the recommended command is a consent-marked phase entry, e.g. the gate-passed phrasing recommending /orbit:apply), add the corresponding tasks.md entry (review body's final-assessment tables are generated text), and add orbit-review to proposal.md's Modified Capabilities.

findings.title: Program mislabeled 'C-arc D1' (twice) — the program is the D-arc
findings.recommendation: Lines 30 and 78: '(C-arc D1, …)' → '(D-arc Stage D1, …)'. The C-arc is the completed fork program; baking the wrong program name into baseline text is exactly the vocabulary drift audit-drift exists to catch — fix before it syncs.

findings.title: Provenance uncertainty default lives only in design.md, not the spec
findings.recommendation: design.md D1/Risks states 'when provenance is uncertain, treat as AI-mediated (prompt)' — the safe default an implementer must not have to invent. Add it normatively to the Invocation-provenance requirement (one sentence + it is what the bodies' task 2.1 already assumes).

findings.title: Era-boundary mechanism deferred to 'a design.md decision' — a dangling pointer once the change archives
findings.recommendation: The design (D6) settles the mechanism (consent-aware schema version, timestamp fallback), but the delta text says the mechanism 'is a design.md decision of the consent change'. Post-archive, baseline audit-drift would reference a document that left the baseline. Bake the mechanism into the requirement text; drop the deferral sentence.

findings.title: Inner-archive emit consent value under a user-typed bulk is derivable but unstated
findings.recommendation: The prompts requirement covers bulk provenance; the emit-field requirement's scenarios don't show the bulk case. Add one scenario: user-typed /orbit:bulk-archive with confirmed batch → each inner archive emit records consent: "user-invoked".

findings.title: CLAUDE.md's execution-disciplines section gains the fourth discipline at archive
findings.recommendation: CLAUDE.md lists the three disciplines; post-archive there are four (no-chaining). Standard archive-time CLAUDE.md update — extend task 4.4's sync note to include it so it isn't rediscovered.

iteration_note: First proposal-mode run for this change.
